exclusions: No use of atomic_scaled as abundances
No interpolation of all62 Y without component contract
No clipping or renormalization of donor isotope inventory

label_mapping.rule: Verify labels actually read and build exact mapping; array position alone is insufficient

normalization.beta: A dot x_star in consumer labels
normalization.ne_m3: nb*q dot Y == r*q dot x_star

normalization.projective_jacobian: D=(I-Y A^T)/beta; A^T D=0; D*x=0; beta*D is idempotent

geometry.absolute_elapsed_time: not required for fixed-epoch local proper-time callback; do not equate linear saved elapsed-time interpolation with exact integral1/H

beta positive; A dot Y=1; ne reconstruction; nb*Y=r*x; zero-inventory n/T remains zero only if both endpoint columns are zero
